Showers, flush toilets, water and 50 amp electric hookups provided'; 'a 188-acre park located on the shores of Tuttle Creek Lake'; amenities Accessible Flush Toilets, Drinking Water, Showers; facility_phone 785-539-8511; rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0; notices 'Check-In and Check-Out are now scheduled for 4:00 PM', 'Camp host is located next to the shower building on the hill above the campground'.
